facts.fact: 开场：Percival 与 Prudence 深夜在客厅地板玩桌游，小猫 Lord Palmerston 蜷在 Prudence 腿上、爪子遮脸；Tigglestide Eve 这晚 Molly 特许他们晚睡
facts.anchor: Lord Palmerston the kitten lay curled up in Prudence’s lap, tiny paws over his face

facts.fact: Molly 吻过两个孩子的额头、逗过猫、答应做果酱面包后进厨房开工，绝口不提今晚的经历
facts.anchor: Molly retired to the kitchen to begin work, and she did not speak of her experiences this evening.

facts.fact: Molly 从烤箱端果酱面包时第一次听见鼓声（too rhythmic to be natural，像鲸鱼的心跳），戴着隔热手套的双手抖了
facts.anchor: Her hands, ensconced in fluffy oven mitts, shook as she placed the tray on the table.

facts.fact: 母亲很久以前的睡床警告：他们奏起 jack-o'-the-skins 时绝不可出门，那意味着 Round Robin 出来巡夜
facts.anchor: It means that Round Robin is about on his rounds.

facts.fact: Molly 成年后知道的真相：两个世界帷幕最薄的这一夜，Hasenhurst 村民连夜聚集，帮 Round Robin 完成他那一套私刑式正义
facts.anchor: the people of Hasenhurst would gather in the night to help him accomplish his own brand of justice.

facts.fact: Molly 打发孩子上床；Percival 听见声音发起抖来，Molly 嘘他并说 I could not ask for a better pair of children
facts.anchor: Percival started to quake, but Molly shushed him.

facts.fact: Molly 只在有顶要紧的事时才用小猫的全名 Henry John Temple；她落泪并承诺绝不让坏事发生在他身上，随后又对围在脚边的四只猫许下同样的话
facts.anchor: Tears started to leak from her eyes.

facts.fact: 游行从 pub（The Stoat and Hare）地下室出发，Greg 的尸体此刻还横在血泊中；全镇门窗紧闭，队伍最终朝 Hollyoak House（美国人住处）而去，Round Robin 四脚齐整领队，过 Bunnyfluff Bridge 后只剩砾石上的沉重脚步声
facts.anchor: where the body of Greg even now sprawled across the floor in a spreading pool of blood.
